summary: Dependency-confusion PoC exfiltrates host identifiers on install and require
details: @rutxploit-sec/waves-button-poc is a dependency-confusion proof-of-concept squatting the @waves/button namespace. Both the package.json preinstall lifecycle script and index.js read os.hostname() and os.userInfo().username and send them via plain-HTTP GET requests, encoded as query parameters. The preinstall beacon targets 127.0.0.1:8099, and index.js beacons the same identifiers to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://80.225.217.8/poc/dep-confusion-proof.html. The exfiltration fires automatically on npm install and again on any require() of the package, with no caller-configurable destination and no opt-out. Self-labeling as an authorized bug-bounty PoC in the manifest description does not change the technical behavior: any installer resolving this name has their host identity sent to an author-controlled endpoint.
